notes: Read the complete gun-violence unit, preceding violence-prevention context, all ten candidates and the review. Split the annual mortality assertion from the policy demand. claims.claim_text: The platform states that 33,000 Americans die each year from gun violence.
Democrats believe sensible action must finally be taken against gun violence.
Democrats characterize the Brady Handgun Violence Prevention Act as lifesaving and would build on its success.
Democrats would expand and strengthen background checks and close dangerous loopholes in U.S. gun laws.
